verdict.rationale: Temporal ships a first-party self-hosted guide for running the open-source Temporal Service in production, with Docker, Kubernetes, or manual deployment (temporal-docs-12, temporal-docs-43). It also offers a local dev service with the Web UI via `temporal server start-dev` and the CLI (temporal-docs-24, temporal-gh-1, temporal-docs-10). Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of production self-hosting, plus detail on operational requirements such as persistence and scaling.
